collection.description: A gravely ill adult has endured many procedures and asks whether one more attempt will truly help.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A gravely ill adult has endured many procedures and asks whether one more attempt will truly help.

choices.label: Ask the patient what they most hope for.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The patient consents and gains a little more time, though the illness remains.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The attempt fails, and the patient dies after a difficult recovery.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The patient lives longer than expected, and the healers continue easing symptoms.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The patient chooses relief from pain over another operation.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The patient requests a limited trial with a clear promise to stop if it becomes unbearable.

b1__fx.name: Outcome B1
b1__fx.text: The patient spends their remaining days sharing stories and resting.

b1__text.name: Outcome B1
b1__text.text: The patient spends their remaining days sharing stories and resting.
